say:0:1210901001:0.text: Let's go. Perhaps each step will bring us closer to the treasure.
say:0:1210901001:0.source_cn: 总之，走吧，也许每一步都更离宝藏更近了呢。

say:2:1210901003:0.text: Slow down, or else you'll trip.

say:0:1210902001:0.text: Look over there! There's a massive whirlpool out in the distance!
say:0:1210902001:0.source_cn: 我看见了！远处的海面上有一个大漩涡！

say:1:1210902002:0.text: This must be what the song meant by saying <style="highlight">we'll reach the treasure once our ship reaches the vortex</style>.
say:1:1210902002:0.source_cn: 民谣里唱的是<style=highlight>待我船至...

say:0:1210904001:0.text: Ack! The seawater is so salty!

say:1:1210904002:0.text: There's a small island up ahead; it must be the trial grounds!
say:1:1210904002:0.source_cn: 前方有个小岛，应该是试炼地！朝着目标前进吧！

say:1:1210905001:1.text: Could this be the trial grounds from the folk song? It's another deserted island.
say:1:1210905001:1.source_cn: 这就是民谣里的试炼地？又一个没人的荒岛。

say:3:1210905002:1.text: Sister, look! There's a treasure chest!
say:3:1210905002:1.source_cn: 姐姐，前面！快看，是宝箱啊！

say:6:1210905003:1.text: Nara, don't run off like that!

say:8:1210905004:1.text: Magister, that chest gives Chippy a bad feeling...
say:8:1210905004:1.source_cn: 主人，那个宝箱看起来有点奇怪！
say:8:1210905004:1.male: Magister, that chest gives Chippy a bad feeling...
say:8:1210905004:1.female: Magister, that chest gives Chippy a bad feeling...

say:1:1210908001:1.source_cn: 唉……果然中招了……大家都没事吧？

say:2:1210908002:1.text: One, two, three, four, five... With me, there's six. Whew, everyone's okay!
say:2:1210908002:1.source_cn: 一、二、三、四、五……算上我，六个。还好还好……都在。

choice_prompt:3:1210908002.text: One, two, three, four, five... With me, there's six. Whew, everyone's okay!
choice_prompt:3:1210908002.source_cn: 一、二、三、四、五……算上我，六个。还好还好……都在。

say:5:1210908005:1.text: That was a trap, designed to teleport anyone who opens it without permission to dangerous places.
say:5:1210908005:1.source_cn: 那个宝箱是陷阱宝箱，会把擅自打开它的人传送到某些危险区域。

say:6:1210908006:1.text: Those traps are usually meant for thieves, teleporting them into pits filled with knives or cages with hungry lions...
say:6:1210908006:1.source_cn: 这种陷阱一般用来对付盗贼，往往会把人传到什么布满了刀的...

say:8:1210908007:1.text: But we got lucky. This place doesn't seem very dangerous.
say:8:1210908007:1.source_cn: ……看来我们运气好，这附近不像有什么机关。

say:10:1210908008:1.text: Sorry, Sonja... It's my fault for getting too excited.
say:10:1210908008:1.source_cn: 对、对不起，索尼娅姐姐，是我……太贪玩了。

say:12:1210908009:1.text: Don't blame yourself, Nara. Chippy would do the same thing in front of pretty treasure like that!
say:12:1210908009:1.source_cn: 不怪奈拉啦，要是满满看到宝箱，也会第一时间打开的。

choice_prompt:14:1210908009.text: Don't blame yourself, Nara. Chippy would do the same thing in front of pretty treasure like that!
choice_prompt:14:1210908009.source_cn: 不怪奈拉啦，要是满满看到宝箱，也会第一时间打开的。

say:16:1210908011:1.text: You're even comforting me. You're so kind!
say:16:1210908011:1.source_cn: 你不怪我，还安慰我！你真好！
say:16:1210908011:1.male: You're even comforting me. You're so kind!
say:16:1210908011:1.female: You're even comforting me. You're so kind!

say:17:1210908013:1.text: Nara, you agreed not to act too impulsively.
say:17:1210908013:1.source_cn: 奈拉，我们约定好了，不能冲动。

say:18:1210908014:1.text: I pinky promise, it won't happen again!

say:20:1210908015:1.text: Alright, alright, enough with the lecture. Let's get out of here.
say:20:1210908015:1.source_cn: 好了好了，对小孩的教育就到此为止，我们赶紧离开吧。

say:21:1210908016:1.text: Even though there aren't any visible dangers nearby, we should still be cautious.
say:21:1210908016:1.source_cn: 毕竟这里是陷阱区，虽然一时半会还没遇到危险，但是小心点...

say:22:1210908017:1.text: Sonja, could you hold my hand?
say:22:1210908017:1.source_cn: 姐姐，可以抓住我的手吗？

say:25:1210908012:1.text: Yes... I know adults don't like disobedient kids. I'll be better next time!
say:25:1210908012:1.source_cn: 知道了……下次我会听话的……
say:25:1210908012:1.male: Yes... I know adults don't like disobedient kids. I'll be better next time!
say:25:1210908012:1.female: Yes... I know adults don't like disobedient kids. I'll be better next time!

say:0:1210910001:0.text: This path looks quite dangerous... Do we have to go through?
say:0:1210910001:0.source_cn: 前面好危险……真的要过去吗？

say:1:1210910002:0.text: The other path is blocked by vines, this is our only option. Don't hesitate now.
say:1:1210910002:0.source_cn: 右边的路被藤蔓堵了，只有这条路能走，别犹豫。

say:0:1210912001:0.text: Ooh, what's this? It looks like a mechanism.

say:1:1210912002:0.text: Hey, great job! Look what you found!

say:0:1210913001:0.text: The door's open! We can backtrack now.
say:0:1210913001:0.source_cn: 门开了！我们可以原路返回了。

say:0:1210914001:0.text: We've gone in a big circle... Hopefully it'll be smoother from here?
say:0:1210914001:0.source_cn: 绕了好大一圈……接下来应该能轻松点了吧？

say:0:1210915001:0.text: W-what? This looks even more dangerous than before!
say:0:1210915001:0.source_cn: 这这这！比之前更危险了呀！

say:1:1210915002:0.text: Traps set for treasure thieves could never be that simple.
say:1:1210915002:0.source_cn: 果然……为寻宝者设下的陷阱，不可能这么简单。

say:1:1210916001:1.text: Sinbad... Please tell me we won't run into any more wild beasts.
say:1:1210916001:1.source_cn: 辛巴达……前面还、还会有冲来冲去的野兽吗？

say:3:1210916002:1.text: It's hard to say. But come on, we'll get through this together!
say:3:1210916002:1.source_cn: 不好说啊，我倒是希望它们能换点花样。

say:5:1210916004:1.text: Stay strong, Hammie! We're definitely getting closer to the treasure now!
say:5:1210916004:1.source_cn: 打起精神，至少我们离宝藏越来越近了！

say:7:1210916005:1.text: Sinbad, you seem to know a lot about adventures and treasure hunting.
say:7:1210916005:1.source_cn: 辛巴达，你好像对冒险和寻宝很有经验。

say:8:1210916006:1.text: It would've been dangerous if we hadn't had you back there.
say:8:1210916006:1.source_cn: 刚才如果没有你，一定很危险。

say:9:1210916007:1.text: This is nothing! My old man used to adventure everywhere. I've learned all sorts of stuff from his mishaps.
say:9:1210916007:1.source_cn: 这不算什么，我那个当船长的老爹，去过各种地方冒险，这些...

say:10:1210916008:1.text: When my hands were too small to even hold a compass, he'd tell me tales of his adventures. With so many stories, it's hard not to remember them all.
say:10:1210916008:1.source_cn: 在我的手掌小得还握不住罗盘的时候，他就开始给我讲各种各...

say:11:1210916009:1.text: I dreamed of becoming a captain like him, sailing ships across the seas! But... well, life had other plans.
say:11:1210916009:1.source_cn: 我小时候啊，还梦想像他一样，长大了做个船长，驾着船四处...

say:12:1210916010:1.text: But what? Why didn't you follow in your dad's footsteps?
say:12:1210916010:1.source_cn: 可惜什么？辛巴达为什么没有成为船长，出海冒险呢？

say:13:1210916011:1.text: Well... *Sigh* You've been to Brineville, yeah? You can guess why.
say:13:1210916011:1.source_cn: 我……唉，你们也去过小水村了，即使我不说，也猜得到吧？

choice_prompt:14:1210916011.text: Well... *Sigh* You've been to Brineville, yeah? You can guess why.
choice_prompt:14:1210916011.source_cn: 我……唉，你们也去过小水村了，即使我不说，也猜得到吧？

say:15:1210916012:1.text: If only he hadn't left with all the other men... My old man left me with quite a mess to clean up, didn't he? Maybe one day, I'll see him again...
say:15:1210916012:1.source_cn: 对啊，我老爹扔下的烂摊子，我得给他打理好吧？也许哪天再...
say:15:1210916012:1.male: If only he hadn't left with all the other men... My old man left me with quite a mess to clean up, didn't he? Maybe one day, I'll see him again...
say:15:1210916012:1.female: If only he hadn't left with all the other men... My old man left me with quite a mess to clean up, didn't he? Maybe one day, I'll see him again...

say:16:1210916013:1.text: In adventure stories, there's always an underdog that rises above all his misfortune. Perhaps he'll...
say:16:1210916013:1.source_cn: 冒险故事里总有人能绝处逢生，说不定他也……
say:16:1210916013:1.male: In adventure stories, there's always an underdog that rises above all his misfortune. Perhaps he'll...
say:16:1210916013:1.female: In adventure stories, there's always an underdog that rises above all his misfortune. Perhaps he'll...

say:17:1210916014:1.text: Ah, I know I'm daydreaming! But it doesn't hurt to dream once in a while.
say:17:1210916014:1.source_cn: 我知道是白日梦！但偶尔做做也不坏。
say:17:1210916014:1.male: Ah, I know I'm daydreaming! But it doesn't hurt to dream once in a while.
say:17:1210916014:1.female: Ah, I know I'm daydreaming! But it doesn't hurt to dream once in a while.

say:18:1210916016:1.text: That's so sad... Whenever Sinbad talks about adventure and treasure hunting, his eyes just light up!
say:18:1210916016:1.source_cn: 太可惜了，明明……辛巴达说起冒险和寻宝的时候，眼睛都在...

say:19:1210916017:1.text: You know, I've actually been to sea before. Before Rustport got sealed off, I'd sail out sometimes just to get some fresh air. I still remember how bright the stars were back then.
say:19:1210916017:1.source_cn: 其实，我也不是没有出过海，锈锚港被封锁之前，我也偶尔会...

say:20:1210916018:1.text: Afterward, I tried to navigate through the mist, but that eerie mist seemed to play games with me. No matter which way I went, I couldn't find a way out. I almost died at sea that time.
say:20:1210916018:1.source_cn: 锈锚港被封锁之后，我也试着穿越迷雾，但是……那诡异的雾...

say:22:1210916020:1.text: Let's not dwell on the past. The trials are waiting for us!
say:22:1210916020:1.source_cn: 以前的事就不提了，还有试炼在等着我们呢！

say:23:1210916021:1.text: My mothers will worry for me if I don't get off this island. I can't let them down. Let's go!
say:23:1210916021:1.source_cn: 要是没法离开小岛，我的母亲们就该替我担心了，我可不能让...

say:25:1210916015:1.text: Yeah... I can't help but worry about the folks back in the village. They've always been there for me. So that's where I gotta stay, for now.
say:25:1210916015:1.source_cn: 嗯……实在放心不下村里那些人，一直是她们在照顾我。所以...
say:25:1210916015:1.male: Yeah... I can't help but worry about the folks back in the village. They've always been there for me. So that's where I gotta stay, for now.
say:25:1210916015:1.female: Yeah... I can't help but worry about the folks back in the village. They've always been there for me. So that's where I gotta stay, for now.

say:0:1210916101:0.text: Hang in there, guys! The path to the treasure will be full of challenges, but it'll definitely be worth it.
say:0:1210916101:0.source_cn: 朋友们，坚持一下，找到宝藏之前的路途都是充满挑战的。

say:0:1210917001:0.text: There's another stone tablet up ahead, just like the ones we've seen before. Let's see what's written on it.
say:0:1210917001:0.source_cn: 那后面有块石碑，和我们先前遇到的很像！上面一定记载着什么。

say:1:1210917002:0.text: Outta the way, you big brick!
say:1:1210917002:0.source_cn: 这些挡路的家伙，赶紧给我让开！

say:3:1210918002:1.text: Ah, the <style="highlight">keys to the three trials</style>... Doesn't this correspond to the hint on the previous tablet?

say:4:1210918003:0.text: So that tells us from here, we can reach the islands of the three trials and complete them to obtain the three keys!
say:4:1210918003:0.source_cn: 这意思是说我们可以从这里去三个试炼的岛，通过试炼，就能...

say:5:1210918004:0.text: Chippy sees now! We'll bring back the keys to the stone tablet from earlier and that should open the door to the treasure!
say:5:1210918004:0.source_cn: 满满也明白了，把拿到的钥匙带回刚才的石碑那里，就能开启...

say:6:1210918005:1.text: But I'm worried about these trials, they're probably super difficult...
say:6:1210918005:1.source_cn: 唔，这三个试炼，分别是什么呢？有点担心……

say:8:1210918006:0.text: Didn't Tritonus give us some hints?
say:8:1210918006:0.source_cn: 特勒米琉斯不是都给我们提示了吗？

choice_prompt:9:1210918006.text: Didn't Tritonus give us some hints?
choice_prompt:9:1210918006.source_cn: 特勒米琉斯不是都给我们提示了吗？

say:10:1210918007:0.text: The trial for this key most likely involves something related to <style="highlight">running</style>. Maybe we'll have to participate in a sprinting race.
say:10:1210918007:0.male: The trial for this key most likely involves something related to <style="highlight">running</style>. Maybe we'll have to participate in a sprinting race.
say:10:1210918007:0.female: The trial for this key most likely involves something related to <style="highlight">running</style>. Maybe we'll have to participate in a sprinting race.

say:11:1210918008:0.text: Hmm. When fishermen or sailors mention cycles, they're speaking of the <style="highlight">cycle of life</style>. Since it's a trial from the god of the waves, maybe we'll have to go fishing!
say:11:1210918008:0.male: Hmm. When fishermen or sailors mention cycles, they're speaking of the <style="highlight">cycle of life</style>. Since it's a trial from the god of the waves, maybe we'll have to go fishing!
say:11:1210918008:0.female: Hmm. When fishermen or sailors mention cycles, they're speaking of the <style="highlight">cycle of life</style>. Since it's a trial from the god of the waves, maybe we'll have to go fishing!

say:12:1210918009:0.text: The trial for this key sounds like it requires <style="highlight">stealth</style>! Perhaps we'll have to sneak across some fearsome guards to grab the key!
say:12:1210918009:0.male: The trial for this key sounds like it requires <style="highlight">stealth</style>! Perhaps we'll have to sneak across some fearsome guards to grab the key!
say:12:1210918009:0.female: The trial for this key sounds like it requires <style="highlight">stealth</style>! Perhaps we'll have to sneak across some fearsome guards to grab the key!

say:13:1210918010:1.text: Shall we go to these trial locations next? The stone tablet also said to <style="highlight">heed the direction of the wind's whisper</style>, but I don't understand what that means.
say:13:1210918010:1.source_cn: 那我们接下来就去找试炼的地方？石碑说在<style=h...

say:14:1210918011:1.text: I think I get it, it means we should head towards where the wind is blowing. The wind here blows from <style="highlight">south to north</style>. Let's explore the island first and see if there's a place to take a boat!
say:14:1210918011:1.source_cn: 我大概明白。我们所在的位置吹的是<style=high...

say:15:1210918012:1.text: In any case, the three trial islands we're looking for must be not far from this stone tablet.
say:15:1210918012:1.source_cn: 总之，和这块石碑相隔不远的海域上，一定有我们要找的三个...

say:16:1210918013:1.text: We're so lucky to have Sinbad here!

choice:9:3:4.text: That makes sense, Sinbad. Good thinking.
choice:9:3:4.male: That makes sense, Sinbad. Good thinking.
choice:9:3:4.female: That makes sense, Sinbad. Good thinking.

say:4:1210903001:1.text: This must be the vortex mentioned in the folk song. It's the gateway to the <style="highlight"><style="highlight">trial grounds</style></style>!
say:4:1210903001:1.source_cn: 我认为这就是那首民谣里提及的旋涡，它是通往<style...

say:6:1210903002:1.text: This whirlpool... It feels like a magic circle!
say:6:1210903002:1.source_cn: 这个旋涡……有点像传送魔法阵？

say:8:1210903003:0.text: If it works by teleporting you to another location, Chippy thinks it should be safe! At least it'd be safer than Cassadee's way of teleporting... right?
say:8:1210903003:0.source_cn: 如果和传送魔法阵的原理一样，应该不会很危险。\n至少比...

say:9:1210903004:0.text: Then let's sail the boat straight into it!
say:9:1210903004:0.source_cn: 既然这样，我们直接把船开进去吧！

choice_prompt:11:1210903004.text: Then let's sail the boat straight into it!
choice_prompt:11:1210903004.source_cn: 既然这样，我们直接把船开进去吧！

say:12:1210903005:0.text: C'mon, what's life without a little adventure? Don't be afraid, I'm right here with ya!
say:12:1210903005:0.source_cn: 没有危险，怎么称得上是冒险呢？来吧，朋友们。别害怕！

say:14:1210903007:1.text: Sinbad, you always surprise me with your ideas...

say:16:1210903008:1.text: Well, this one seems super-duper fun! I love a bit of danger! Charge!!
say:16:1210903008:1.source_cn: 我喜欢冒险！也喜欢疯狂！冲呀——！

say:18:1210903006:0.text: Hold on tight, and don't let go!
say:18:1210903006:0.source_cn: 抓稳咯，千万别被甩下去。
say:18:1210903006:0.male: Hold on tight, and don't let go!
say:18:1210903006:0.female: Hold on tight, and don't let go!

narration:19:12010913:0.text: While sailing on the sea, you come across a massive vortex.
narration:19:12010913:0.source_cn: 你们乘着船在大海上航行，发现了一个大漩涡。

cinematic_dialogue:1:1210906001:.text: Hey! I found the treasure first!

narration:2:1210907001:0.text: Regrettably, it was too late; strange magic envelopes you all, and everything begins spinning before your eyes...
narration:2:1210907001:0.source_cn: 晚了一步，奇异的魔力已然包围了我们，眼前天旋地转……

cinematic_dialogue:4:1210906001:.text: Hey! I found the treasure first!
